conditions.name: ConditionReachable
conditions.description: the management endpoint answers Redfish over its address.

conditions.name: ConditionInventoried
conditions.description: discovery has populated the endpoint's status facts.

conditions.name: ConditionVerified
conditions.description: org assertion matches discovery (Asset serial vs Redfish — two independent origins). False is alert-and-hold, never destructive.

conditions.name: ConditionConfigured
conditions.description: the matched EndpointProfile is applied (creds/TLS/NTP).

conditions.name: ConditionInspected
conditions.description: the host's hardware inventory is gathered.

conditions.name: ConditionFirmwareConverged
conditions.description: firmware matches the matched FirmwareProfile. Firmware converges before BIOS — the BIOS schema depends on firmware.

conditions.name: ConditionBiosConverged
conditions.description: BIOS settings match the materialized BiosSettings.

conditions.name: ConditionBooted
conditions.description: the OS payload has been handed off and the machine came up.

conditions.name: ConditionOSReady
conditions.description: the node reports OS-level readiness (Talos machine status).

conditions.name: ConditionDrifted
conditions.description: the world moved with no active HostOperation (e.g. a LastResetTime advance) — information, not error.

conditions.name: ConditionApprovalPending
conditions.description: a proposed HostOperation awaits its human gate.

conditions.name: ConditionMaintenance
conditions.description: a person put the host in maintenance (annotation metal.pk.io/maintenance); the message is their reason. Absent otherwise.

conditions.name: ConditionBound
conditions.description: the HostClaim holds its Host (the authoritative pointer is Host.spec.claimRef; this condition is the claim's view of it).

conditions.name: ConditionProvisioned
conditions.description: on a HostClaim with OS intent — the bound machine runs the named node's config. False carries what the operator waits on or why it holds; True means the hand-off happened.

conditions.name: ConditionDeletionHeld
conditions.description: on a Host or ManagementEndpoint. A person deleted it, but a claim still holds the machine. The object stays (finalizer metal.pk.io/claim-protection) until the claim releases the machine.

conditions.name: ConditionConverged
conditions.description: on a BiosSettings — the machine's managed attributes match the materialized desired state. The Host's BiosConverged mirrors it.

conditions.name: ConditionApproved
conditions.description: the HostOperation's human gate. False is AwaitingApproval; True carries who (or that the disruption policy waived it).

conditions.name: ConditionExecuted
conditions.description: the HostOperation's outcome. Unknown while queued or executing; a False is terminal — disruptive one-shots never auto-retry.

conditions.name: ConditionMaterialized
conditions.description: on an Asset — the operator found the BMC's address in the ledger and created the ManagementEndpoint for it. False says what is missing; nothing about the machine is known until it is True.

conditions.name: ConditionSystemFirmwareConverged
conditions.description: on a Host, whether the system firmware (BIOS/UEFI, NIC, RAID) its FirmwareProfiles ask for is what the inventory reports. Absent when no profile asks for any.

conditions.name: ConditionDiskWiped
conditions.description: whether the machine's disks are known to be free of an installed node. False (reason InstalledNodeRemains) while AnnotationDiskNotWiped is set; absent otherwise.

conditions.name: ConditionValid
conditions.description: on a MaintenanceWindow, whether the operator can read it.

conditions.name: ConditionRendered
conditions.description: the TalosNode's machine config is rendered into its config Secret at the current generation.

conditions.name: ConditionReady
conditions.description: the BootAsset's artifact exists and is fetchable (built into its artifact Secret, or, factory, addressed by a computed URL). On a TalosNode it is the check-in verdict instead: the machine's aggregated status reports stage running and ready.

conditions.name: ConditionMachineReachable
conditions.description: the machine behind a hand-off answers its Talos API at the node's address, over the authenticated machine API or, blank, the maintenance service. Only observed while a Host hands this node a machine.

conditions.name: ConditionBootstrapped
conditions.description: a TalosCluster's etcd exists. Observed: True when a control-plane member reports etcd members or the Kubernetes API answers. The first True is also remembered, as status.bootstrappedAt, so that a cluster whose etcd data is lost is never bootstrapped again.

conditions.name: ConditionAvailable
conditions.description: a TalosCluster's Kubernetes API answers and every member TalosNode is Ready. A member is a TalosNode a machine is handed.

conditions.name: ConditionRemovalBlocked
conditions.description: on a TalosNode being deleted, what its deletion still waits for: the removal of its machine (drain, etcd leave, reset) or its etcd member. Only present during deletion.

conditions.name: ConditionConfigInSync
conditions.description: a dry-run apply of the rendered config against the machine reports no change. False with reason ConfigDrift says what differs and whether it needs a reboot.

conditions.name: ConditionVersionCurrent
conditions.description: the machine runs the Talos version the cluster asks for. False with reason VersionSkew while it runs another one; the config is then rendered for the version it runs.

conditions.name: ConditionVersionsSupported
conditions.description: Talos supports the Kubernetes version the spec asks for. False with reason UnsupportedVersionPair otherwise, and nothing renders.

conditions.name: ConditionVersionsCurrent
conditions.description: every machine runs the Talos version and the Kubernetes API runs the Kubernetes version the spec asks for.

conditions.name: ConditionSecretsBundleHeld
conditions.description: True while the secrets bundle of the spec is not the bundle that the machines run. The operator then continues to use the bundle that they run (reason BundleChanged).

conditions.name: ConditionPlanned
conditions.description: ConditionPlanned, ConditionApproved, ConditionProgressing, ConditionPaused and ConditionComplete (declared with the backup kinds, which use it the same way) are a TalosRollout's.

conditions.name: ConditionBackedUp
conditions.description: a verified snapshot newer than twice the interval exists.

conditions.name: ConditionComplete
conditions.description: taking it has ended, stored (True) or failed (False). A TalosRollout uses it too: every node done.

conditions.name: ConditionVerified
conditions.description: the snapshot is an intact etcd database and the sink holds what was sent.

reasons.name: ReasonAwaitingApproval
reasons.description: the gate is required and unstamped.
reasons.context: Reasons on the operation's Approved / Executed conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonApproved
reasons.description: a human stamped approvedBy, and admission confirmed they stamped it as themselves.
reasons.context: Reasons on the operation's Approved / Executed conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonApprovalNotRequired
reasons.description: the disruption policy waived the gate.
reasons.context: Reasons on the operation's Approved / Executed conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonOperationQueued
reasons.description: another operation holds the host — at most one runs per Host.
reasons.context: Reasons on the operation's Approved / Executed conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonExecuting
reasons.description: the baseline is persisted and steps are being issued.
reasons.context: Reasons on the operation's Approved / Executed conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonStepsSucceeded
reasons.description: every action converged to its goal.
reasons.context: Reasons on the operation's Approved / Executed conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonStepFailed
reasons.description: a step failed — terminal, a human decides.
reasons.context: Reasons on the operation's Approved / Executed conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonHostNotFound
reasons.description: hostRef names no Host (yet).
reasons.context: Reasons on the operation's Approved / Executed conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonHostNotClaimed
reasons.description: the boot of a claim was about to start, but the claim is in deletion or no longer holds the host. The operation did not touch the machine.
reasons.context: Reasons on the operation's Approved / Executed conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonNoReachablePath
reasons.description: every management path is down.
reasons.context: Reasons on the operation's Approved / Executed conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonClusterDisruption
reasons.description: the operation would take down a control plane of a Talos cluster. But another control plane of that cluster is going down, or etcd is not fully healthy without this member. The operation starts when that is over.
reasons.context: Reasons on the operation's Approved / Executed conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonAborted
reasons.description: a person asked the operation to stop (annotation metal.pk.io/abort, pk-metal abort). It stopped between two steps and undid what it could; the message says what.
reasons.context: Reasons on the operation's Approved / Executed conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonNodeNotFound
reasons.description: the machine was told to run an OS whose TalosNode does not exist — provisioning is engaged but there is nothing to render. Someone named a node that was never authored.
reasons.context: Reasons on the host's Booted / OSReady conditions. Both mirror the bound TalosNode's check-in observations (MachineAPI, MaintenanceMode, NodeReady, Converging pass through verbatim); these two originate on the Host side.

reasons.name: ReasonAwaitingContact
reasons.description: no check-in observation yet.
reasons.context: Reasons on the host's Booted / OSReady conditions. Both mirror the bound TalosNode's check-in observations (MachineAPI, MaintenanceMode, NodeReady, Converging pass through verbatim); these two originate on the Host side.

reasons.name: ReasonInSync
reasons.description: observed matches desired.
reasons.context: Reasons on the convergence conditions (BiosSettings' Converged, the Host's FirmwareConverged / BiosConverged). Each hold alerts and holds: the condition blocks, and nothing destructive follows. An unchanged planHash never makes a second operation. To continue, a person changes the desired state (a profile edit), which changes the hash.

reasons.name: ReasonAwaitingOperation
reasons.description: drift is real and the proposed operation exists but has not finished (it may still await its human gate — the Host's ApprovalPending says so).
reasons.context: Reasons on the convergence conditions (BiosSettings' Converged, the Host's FirmwareConverged / BiosConverged). Each hold alerts and holds: the condition blocks, and nothing destructive follows. An unchanged planHash never makes a second operation. To continue, a person changes the desired state (a profile edit), which changes the hash.

reasons.name: ReasonOperationFailed
reasons.description: the proposed operation failed — terminal for this plan, one-shots never auto-retry.
reasons.context: Reasons on the convergence conditions (BiosSettings' Converged, the Host's FirmwareConverged / BiosConverged). Each hold alerts and holds: the condition blocks, and nothing destructive follows. An unchanged planHash never makes a second operation. To continue, a person changes the desired state (a profile edit), which changes the hash.

reasons.name: ReasonOperationGone
reasons.description: the proposed operation no longer exists while drift persists — a human deleted the proposal (a veto).
reasons.context: Reasons on the convergence conditions (BiosSettings' Converged, the Host's FirmwareConverged / BiosConverged). Each hold alerts and holds: the condition blocks, and nothing destructive follows. An unchanged planHash never makes a second operation. To continue, a person changes the desired state (a profile edit), which changes the hash.

reasons.name: ReasonConvergenceFailed
reasons.description: the operation succeeded, but the machine does not show the desired state. For example, a flash reported success but changed nothing, or a BIOS apply lost the value.
reasons.context: Reasons on the convergence conditions (BiosSettings' Converged, the Host's FirmwareConverged / BiosConverged). Each hold alerts and holds: the condition blocks, and nothing destructive follows. An unchanged planHash never makes a second operation. To continue, a person changes the desired state (a profile edit), which changes the hash.

reasons.name: ReasonProfileConflict
reasons.description: two same-layer profiles set the same key to different values — the materialization holds whole.
reasons.context: Reasons on the convergence conditions (BiosSettings' Converged, the Host's FirmwareConverged / BiosConverged). Each hold alerts and holds: the condition blocks, and nothing destructive follows. An unchanged planHash never makes a second operation. To continue, a person changes the desired state (a profile edit), which changes the hash.

reasons.name: ReasonSchemaViolation
reasons.description: a desired value is not in the discovered attribute registry (an unknown attribute, or a value out of the enum). The machine would refuse or ignore it, so the operator proposes nothing.
reasons.context: Reasons on the convergence conditions (BiosSettings' Converged, the Host's FirmwareConverged / BiosConverged). Each hold alerts and holds: the condition blocks, and nothing destructive follows. An unchanged planHash never makes a second operation. To continue, a person changes the desired state (a profile edit), which changes the hash.

reasons.name: ReasonAwaitingFirmware
reasons.description: BIOS holds until firmware converges — the BIOS schema depends on firmware.
reasons.context: Reasons on the convergence conditions (BiosSettings' Converged, the Host's FirmwareConverged / BiosConverged). Each hold alerts and holds: the condition blocks, and nothing destructive follows. An unchanged planHash never makes a second operation. To continue, a person changes the desired state (a profile edit), which changes the hash.

reasons.name: ReasonNoUpdateTransport
reasons.description: no fronting endpoint advertises the proven multipart-push dialect — drift is visible but no flash is proposed over an unproven transport.
reasons.context: Reasons on the convergence conditions (BiosSettings' Converged, the Host's FirmwareConverged / BiosConverged). Each hold alerts and holds: the condition blocks, and nothing destructive follows. An unchanged planHash never makes a second operation. To continue, a person changes the desired state (a profile edit), which changes the hash.

reasons.name: ReasonAwaitingVerification
reasons.description: a profile matches but the endpoint is not Verified — nothing is written to an unproven box.
reasons.context: Reasons on the endpoint's Configured condition (the EndpointProfile lanes). InSync and ProfileConflict are shared with the convergence vocabulary above. There is no operation gate here — merging the profile is the approval — so every False is either in-flight work or an alert-and-hold the next pass retries (the factory account stays as break-glass, faults self-heal).

reasons.name: ReasonRotationFailed
reasons.description: the operator could not set the password of the managed Secret on the managed account, or the BMC did not accept a new password. Neither the managed nor the factory session set a password that logs in. The working password stays in the Secret.
reasons.context: Reasons on the endpoint's Configured condition (the EndpointProfile lanes). InSync and ProfileConflict are shared with the convergence vocabulary above. There is no operation gate here — merging the profile is the approval — so every False is either in-flight work or an alert-and-hold the next pass retries (the factory account stays as break-glass, faults self-heal).

reasons.name: ReasonNTPFailed
reasons.description: the manager's time sources could not be converged — the write failed or did not read back.
reasons.context: Reasons on the endpoint's Configured condition (the EndpointProfile lanes). InSync and ProfileConflict are shared with the convergence vocabulary above. There is no operation gate here — merging the profile is the approval — so every False is either in-flight work or an alert-and-hold the next pass retries (the factory account stays as break-glass, faults self-heal).

reasons.name: ReasonNoIdentityTransport
reasons.description: an identity is desired but the endpoint advertises no way to replace its certificate.
reasons.context: Reasons on the endpoint's Configured condition (the EndpointProfile lanes). InSync and ProfileConflict are shared with the convergence vocabulary above. There is no operation gate here — merging the profile is the approval — so every False is either in-flight work or an alert-and-hold the next pass retries (the factory account stays as break-glass, faults self-heal).

reasons.name: ReasonAwaitingIssuance
reasons.description: the CertificateRequest is created and not yet signed.
reasons.context: Reasons on the endpoint's Configured condition (the EndpointProfile lanes). InSync and ProfileConflict are shared with the convergence vocabulary above. There is no operation gate here — merging the profile is the approval — so every False is either in-flight work or an alert-and-hold the next pass retries (the factory account stays as break-glass, faults self-heal).

reasons.name: ReasonIdentityPushed
reasons.description: the signed certificate went to the manager and the manager was restarted — the next observation decides whether it is being served.
reasons.context: Reasons on the endpoint's Configured condition (the EndpointProfile lanes). InSync and ProfileConflict are shared with the convergence vocabulary above. There is no operation gate here — merging the profile is the approval — so every False is either in-flight work or an alert-and-hold the next pass retries (the factory account stays as break-glass, faults self-heal).

reasons.name: ReasonIdentityPushFailed
reasons.description: the push did not land or the pushed certificate is not being served (success answered, nothing changed — the lying-oracle shape). Held per desired state: a profile edit re-arms the push.
reasons.context: Reasons on the endpoint's Configured condition (the EndpointProfile lanes). InSync and ProfileConflict are shared with the convergence vocabulary above. There is no operation gate here — merging the profile is the approval — so every False is either in-flight work or an alert-and-hold the next pass retries (the factory account stays as break-glass, faults self-heal).

reasons.name: ReasonIdentityPushHeld
reasons.description: the signed certificate is ready, but pushing it restarts the manager, and an operation is running on a machine behind it. A restart drops the virtual media mounts and the session of the step in flight, so the push waits for the operation to finish.
reasons.context: Reasons on the endpoint's Configured condition (the EndpointProfile lanes). InSync and ProfileConflict are shared with the convergence vocabulary above. There is no operation gate here — merging the profile is the approval — so every False is either in-flight work or an alert-and-hold the next pass retries (the factory account stays as break-glass, faults self-heal).

reasons.name: ReasonUnexpectedReset
reasons.description: the reset-time observation advanced with no operation explaining it — someone or something reset the machine.
reasons.context: Reasons on the host's Drifted condition (information, not error).

reasons.name: ReasonResetExplained
reasons.description: the latest advance is covered by an operation's observation.
reasons.context: Reasons on the host's Drifted condition (information, not error).

reasons.name: ReasonHandedOff
reasons.description: the machine checked in with the node's config.
reasons.context: Reasons on the claim's Provisioned condition. All but HandedOff are False: in-flight waits (AwaitingRender, AwaitingBootAsset, AwaitingOperation, Releasing), the install operation's gate (AwaitingApproval, shown as blockedOn Approval(Provisioning)), or alert-and-hold stops (SingleMediumUnsupported, NoBootableMedia, OperationFailed, ReleaseFailed) that a person resolves.

reasons.name: ReasonAwaitingRender
reasons.description: the TalosNode (or its cluster) is missing or has no rendered config yet.
reasons.context: Reasons on the claim's Provisioned condition. All but HandedOff are False: in-flight waits (AwaitingRender, AwaitingBootAsset, AwaitingOperation, Releasing), the install operation's gate (AwaitingApproval, shown as blockedOn Approval(Provisioning)), or alert-and-hold stops (SingleMediumUnsupported, NoBootableMedia, OperationFailed, ReleaseFailed) that a person resolves.

reasons.name: ReasonAwaitingBootAsset
reasons.description: the installer image, the config medium or the installer with the config built in is not built (Ready) for the current render yet.
reasons.context: Reasons on the claim's Provisioned condition. All but HandedOff are False: in-flight waits (AwaitingRender, AwaitingBootAsset, AwaitingOperation, Releasing), the install operation's gate (AwaitingApproval, shown as blockedOn Approval(Provisioning)), or alert-and-hold stops (SingleMediumUnsupported, NoBootableMedia, OperationFailed, ReleaseFailed) that a person resolves.

reasons.name: ReasonSingleMediumUnsupported
reasons.description: the endpoint can hold one virtual medium only, and the machine has no Talos to boot from disk. An installer with the config inside cannot help either. The Talos release of the cluster cannot read one (before 1.12), or the one slot does not boot an ISO.
reasons.context: Reasons on the claim's Provisioned condition. All but HandedOff are False: in-flight waits (AwaitingRender, AwaitingBootAsset, AwaitingOperation, Releasing), the install operation's gate (AwaitingApproval, shown as blockedOn Approval(Provisioning)), or alert-and-hold stops (SingleMediumUnsupported, NoBootableMedia, OperationFailed, ReleaseFailed) that a person resolves.

reasons.name: ReasonNoBootableMedia
reasons.description: the endpoint advertises no insertable media slot or no removable-media boot target.
reasons.context: Reasons on the claim's Provisioned condition. All but HandedOff are False: in-flight waits (AwaitingRender, AwaitingBootAsset, AwaitingOperation, Releasing), the install operation's gate (AwaitingApproval, shown as blockedOn Approval(Provisioning)), or alert-and-hold stops (SingleMediumUnsupported, NoBootableMedia, OperationFailed, ReleaseFailed) that a person resolves.

reasons.name: ReasonReleasing
reasons.description: the claim is being deleted; the release operation (power off, eject) runs before the machine is handed back.
reasons.context: Reasons on the claim's Provisioned condition. All but HandedOff are False: in-flight waits (AwaitingRender, AwaitingBootAsset, AwaitingOperation, Releasing), the install operation's gate (AwaitingApproval, shown as blockedOn Approval(Provisioning)), or alert-and-hold stops (SingleMediumUnsupported, NoBootableMedia, OperationFailed, ReleaseFailed) that a person resolves.

reasons.name: ReasonReleaseFailed
reasons.description: the release operation failed — the machine stays bound until a person deletes the failed operation (which retries it).
reasons.context: Reasons on the claim's Provisioned condition. All but HandedOff are False: in-flight waits (AwaitingRender, AwaitingBootAsset, AwaitingOperation, Releasing), the install operation's gate (AwaitingApproval, shown as blockedOn Approval(Provisioning)), or alert-and-hold stops (SingleMediumUnsupported, NoBootableMedia, OperationFailed, ReleaseFailed) that a person resolves.

reasons.name: ReasonHeldByUser
reasons.description: the claim carries the metal.pk.io/hold annotation — nothing is proposed for it until the annotation is removed.
reasons.context: Reasons on the claim's Provisioned condition. All but HandedOff are False: in-flight waits (AwaitingRender, AwaitingBootAsset, AwaitingOperation, Releasing), the install operation's gate (AwaitingApproval, shown as blockedOn Approval(Provisioning)), or alert-and-hold stops (SingleMediumUnsupported, NoBootableMedia, OperationFailed, ReleaseFailed) that a person resolves.

reasons.name: ReasonHostInMaintenance
reasons.description: the bound host carries the metal.pk.io/maintenance annotation, so the operator proposes nothing for it. It is also the reason on Maintenance=True and on the blockedOn of a host in maintenance. An operation that waits for the end of the maintenance has it on Executed=Unknown.
reasons.context: Reasons on the claim's Provisioned condition. All but HandedOff are False: in-flight waits (AwaitingRender, AwaitingBootAsset, AwaitingOperation, Releasing), the install operation's gate (AwaitingApproval, shown as blockedOn Approval(Provisioning)), or alert-and-hold stops (SingleMediumUnsupported, NoBootableMedia, OperationFailed, ReleaseFailed) that a person resolves.

reasons.name: ReasonSelfDisruption
reasons.description: the step would reboot or power off a machine that the operator needs. This is the node of its pod, or a control plane of the cluster that it runs in. The operator proposes and starts nothing for it, unless the Host has the metal.pk.io/allow-self-disruption annotation. Even then, it takes down only one control plane at a time, and only while etcd keeps a majority. It is the reason on Provisioned=False of a claim, on BiosConverged=False of a host, and on Executed=Unknown of an operation that waits.
reasons.context: Reasons on the claim's Provisioned condition. All but HandedOff are False: in-flight waits (AwaitingRender, AwaitingBootAsset, AwaitingOperation, Releasing), the install operation's gate (AwaitingApproval, shown as blockedOn Approval(Provisioning)), or alert-and-hold stops (SingleMediumUnsupported, NoBootableMedia, OperationFailed, ReleaseFailed) that a person resolves.

reasons.name: ReasonEndpointMaterialized
reasons.description: the endpoint exists.
reasons.context: Reasons on the Asset's Materialized condition.

reasons.name: ReasonNoBMCMac
reasons.description: the Asset names no bmcMac.
reasons.context: Reasons on the Asset's Materialized condition.

reasons.name: ReasonNoLedgerEntry
reasons.description: the bmcMac is not in the ledger.
reasons.context: Reasons on the Asset's Materialized condition.

reasons.name: ReasonLedgerEntryInvalid
reasons.description: the ledger lists the bmcMac on a line that could not be used (not an https URL, or the MAC listed twice with two addresses).
reasons.context: Reasons on the Asset's Materialized condition.

reasons.name: ReasonMaterializeConflict
reasons.description: an endpoint of the same name belongs to another Asset.
reasons.context: Reasons on the Asset's Materialized condition.

reasons.name: ReasonAssetNotMaterialized
reasons.description: the Asset has no endpoint, and its Materialized condition says why.

reasons.name: ReasonHostClaimed
reasons.description: a claim holds the machine.

reasons.name: ReasonHostBound
reasons.description: the bind pointer is ours.
reasons.context: Reasons on the claim's Bound condition. HostNotDiscovered is in flight (the machine hasn't been discovered yet), the rest are blocked states.

reasons.name: ReasonBindRetained
reasons.description: the assetRef no longer resolves but a live bind exists — alert-and-hold, a resolution failure never releases a machine.
reasons.context: Reasons on the claim's Bound condition. HostNotDiscovered is in flight (the machine hasn't been discovered yet), the rest are blocked states.

reasons.name: ReasonAssetNotFound
reasons.description: the referenced Asset does not exist.
reasons.context: Reasons on the claim's Bound condition. HostNotDiscovered is in flight (the machine hasn't been discovered yet), the rest are blocked states.

reasons.name: ReasonHostNotDiscovered
reasons.description: no Host has been discovered for the asset yet.
reasons.context: Reasons on the claim's Bound condition. HostNotDiscovered is in flight (the machine hasn't been discovered yet), the rest are blocked states.

reasons.name: ReasonAmbiguousSystem
reasons.description: the endpoint fronts several systems and no systemRef says which one is meant — a chassis with more than one node in it.
reasons.context: Reasons on the claim's Bound condition. HostNotDiscovered is in flight (the machine hasn't been discovered yet), the rest are blocked states.

reasons.name: ReasonSystemNotFound
reasons.description: systemRef names no system the endpoint fronts.
reasons.context: Reasons on the claim's Bound condition. HostNotDiscovered is in flight (the machine hasn't been discovered yet), the rest are blocked states.

reasons.name: ReasonHostAlreadyClaimed
reasons.description: another claim holds the host (first writer won).
reasons.context: Reasons on the claim's Bound condition. HostNotDiscovered is in flight (the machine hasn't been discovered yet), the rest are blocked states.

reasons.name: ReasonSerialMismatch
reasons.description: the asserted serial is not the discovered one — the machine behind this endpoint is not the machine the org claims.

reasons.name: ReasonMACMismatch
reasons.description: the manager at this address reports a NIC MAC other than the asserted bmcMac — the ledger join resolved to the wrong box.

reasons.name: ReasonIdentityDiverged
reasons.description: two paths to the same serial anchor give different identities. The anchor leads to different machine facts, so no single Host identity exists. The operator alerts and holds.

reasons.name: ReasonNoMatchingComponent
reasons.description: a profile names a component that no FirmwareInventory entry of the machine matches. Nothing is proposed for a component that cannot be found.
reasons.context: Reasons added for day-2 convergence and scheduling. They live apart from conditions.go so that each concern's reasons are found next to each other.

reasons.name: ReasonInstalledNodeMissing
reasons.description: the host's claim says it runs a TalosNode that no longer exists. The node cannot be drained, so no change that reboots the machine is proposed until the record and the node agree.
reasons.context: Reasons added for day-2 convergence and scheduling. They live apart from conditions.go so that each concern's reasons are found next to each other.

reasons.name: ReasonOutsideMaintenanceWindow
reasons.description: a MaintenanceWindow covers its host and none of the windows that cover it is open. The operation starts when one opens; an operation already running is never stopped by a window closing. Also the operation's blockedOn.
reasons.context: Reasons added for day-2 convergence and scheduling. They live apart from conditions.go so that each concern's reasons are found next to each other.

reasons.name: ReasonRolloutRefused
reasons.description: the operation names a TalosRollout (spec.rolloutRef), but the approval of the rollout does not cover it. The rollout is gone, not approved, aborted or approved for another planHash, or its plan gives this node other actions. The machine did not change.

reasons.name: ReasonInstalledNodeRemains
reasons.description: the machine was released without a Talos reset, so its disk may still hold a node of a cluster, credentials included.
reasons.context: Reasons of the node lifecycle.

reasons.name: ReasonDiskNotWiped
reasons.description: the bound host still holds another node's install, and nothing is installed on it until it is wiped.
reasons.context: Reasons of the node lifecycle.

reasons.name: ReasonEtcdJoinWaiting
reasons.description: the claim's node is a control plane of a running cluster. Its install waits until each etcd member is healthy and votes, and no other control plane joins. Control planes join one at a time.
reasons.context: Reasons of the node lifecycle.

reasons.name: ReasonEtcdRiskRefused
reasons.description: the removal or reinstall of the claim's control plane would leave etcd with an even member count, without a healthy majority, or empty. Nobody accepted that risk (AnnotationAckEtcdRisk).
reasons.context: Reasons of the node lifecycle.

reasons.name: ReasonRemovalWaiting
reasons.description: the removal of a control plane waits for its turn. Another control plane is in removal, a member is still a learner, or this one is the etcd leader and others leave too. The leader goes last.
reasons.context: Reasons of the node lifecycle.

reasons.name: ReasonRemovingNode
reasons.description: the claim's TalosNode is being deleted; the removal operation (drain, etcd leave, reset, Node deletion, power off) runs first.
reasons.context: Reasons of the node lifecycle.

reasons.name: ReasonNodeRemoved
reasons.description: the claim's TalosNode was removed from its cluster and the machine wiped; the claim keeps the machine for whatever node it names next.
reasons.context: Reasons of the node lifecycle.

reasons.name: ReasonReinstalling
reasons.description: a reinstall the claim asked for (AnnotationReinstall) is proposed or running.
reasons.context: Reasons of the node lifecycle.

reasons.name: ReasonReplacing
reasons.description: the claim was pointed at another machine, and the one it ran on is being removed first.
reasons.context: Reasons of the node lifecycle.

reasons.name: ReasonWipeRequested
reasons.description: a wipe was asked for and its operation is proposed or running.
reasons.context: Reasons of the node lifecycle.

reasons.name: ReasonWindowValid
reasons.description: ReasonWindowValid on Valid=True.
reasons.context: Reasons on the window's Valid condition.

reasons.name: ReasonWindowInvalid
reasons.description: the message says what is wrong.
reasons.context: Reasons on the window's Valid condition.

reasons.name: ReasonMachineAssigned
reasons.description: a machine still runs or ran the node, and its removal operation has not finished.
reasons.context: Reasons on a TalosNode's RemovalBlocked condition.

reasons.name: ReasonEtcdMemberRemains
reasons.description: etcd still lists a member with the node's hostname.
reasons.context: Reasons on a TalosNode's RemovalBlocked condition.

reasons.name: ReasonEtcdUnreadable
reasons.description: no control plane of the cluster answered, so nothing says the node's etcd member is gone.
reasons.context: Reasons on a TalosNode's RemovalBlocked condition.

reasons.name: ReasonConfigRendered
reasons.description: the config Secret holds the render.
reasons.context: Reasons on the node's Rendered condition.

reasons.name: ReasonClusterNotFound
reasons.description: clusterRef names no TalosCluster.
reasons.context: Reasons on the node's Rendered condition.

reasons.name: ReasonSecretsUnavailable
reasons.description: the secrets bundle Secret is missing, unreadable or invalid. Nothing renders without it.
reasons.context: Reasons on the node's Rendered condition.

reasons.name: ReasonPatchesUnresolvable
reasons.description: a patch names a ConfigMap or key that does not exist.
reasons.context: Reasons on the node's Rendered condition.

reasons.name: ReasonRenderFailed
reasons.description: the inputs do not form a valid Talos configuration (the message carries the render or validation error).
reasons.context: Reasons on the node's Rendered condition.

reasons.name: ReasonSchematicUnavailable
reasons.description: the image factory could not be told about the schematic, so the image it addresses may not exist. Rendering a config that names an installer nothing serves would move the failure onto the machine, where the only witness is a serial console.
reasons.context: Reasons on the node's Rendered condition.

reasons.name: ReasonArtifactBuilt
reasons.description: the artifact Secret holds the built bytes; digest and size are stamped.
reasons.context: Reasons on the asset's Ready condition.

reasons.name: ReasonURLComputed
reasons.description: the image factory knows the schematic, and the content-addressed URL of its image is stamped. The bytes behind that URL are not fetched (the machine does that) but they are known to exist, which a computed URL alone never established.
reasons.context: Reasons on the asset's Ready condition.

reasons.name: ReasonNodeNotFound
reasons.description: nodeRef names no TalosNode.
reasons.context: Reasons on the asset's Ready condition.

reasons.name: ReasonConfigNotRendered
reasons.description: the node exists but has no rendered config Secret yet; the build waits for the render.
reasons.context: Reasons on the asset's Ready condition.

reasons.name: ReasonBuildFailed
reasons.description: packing the artifact failed (the message carries the builder's error).
reasons.context: Reasons on the asset's Ready condition.

reasons.name: ReasonBuilding
reasons.description: the imager Job is building the artifact for the current inputs. A stored artifact of earlier inputs stays in status until the new one replaces it.
reasons.context: Reasons on the asset's Ready condition.

reasons.name: ReasonBuilderUnavailable
reasons.description: this operator cannot build the artifact: no media store, no imager image pinned for the Talos version, or a Talos version without embedded config support. The message names the flag or field to set.
reasons.context: Reasons on the asset's Ready condition.

reasons.name: ReasonMachineAPI
reasons.description: the authenticated machine API answered, so the node runs a config from our PKI.
reasons.context: Reasons on the node's MachineReachable / Ready check-in conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonMaintenanceMode
reasons.description: only the unauthenticated maintenance service answers; the machine is up and blank, awaiting its config.
reasons.context: Reasons on the node's MachineReachable / Ready check-in conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonDialFailed
reasons.description: neither service answered.
reasons.context: Reasons on the node's MachineReachable / Ready check-in conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonNoAddress
reasons.description: the node has neither spec.address nor a static link address, so there is nothing to dial.
reasons.context: Reasons on the node's MachineReachable / Ready check-in conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonAwaitingContact
reasons.description: no observation yet; the machine has never answered since the hand-off.
reasons.context: Reasons on the node's MachineReachable / Ready check-in conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonConverging
reasons.description: the machine answers but has not reached stage running + ready (the message carries stage and unmet conditions).
reasons.context: Reasons on the node's MachineReachable / Ready check-in conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonNodeReady
reasons.description: stage running, all conditions met; the check-in signal that revokes grants and advances the Host to Provisioned.
reasons.context: Reasons on the node's MachineReachable / Ready check-in conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonEtcdRunning
reasons.description: a control-plane member reports etcd members.
reasons.context: Reasons on the cluster's Bootstrapped / Available conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonKubernetesAnswers
reasons.description: no member could be asked about etcd, but the Kubernetes API answers, which it cannot without etcd.
reasons.context: Reasons on the cluster's Bootstrapped / Available conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonBootstrapRequested
reasons.description: the operator asked a control-plane member to bootstrap etcd and waits to observe it running.
reasons.context: Reasons on the cluster's Bootstrapped / Available conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonAwaitingControlPlane
reasons.description: not every control-plane member answers its authenticated API yet. Bootstrap waits for all of them. Thus a member that has bootstrapped already but is down does not look like a new cluster.
reasons.context: Reasons on the cluster's Bootstrapped / Available conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonNoControlPlane
reasons.description: no TalosNode with role controlplane names this cluster.
reasons.context: Reasons on the cluster's Bootstrapped / Available conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonBootstrapRefused
reasons.description: the member refused the bootstrap call (the message carries why; it is retried).
reasons.context: Reasons on the cluster's Bootstrapped / Available conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonEtcdDataLost
reasons.description: the cluster was bootstrapped before (status.bootstrappedAt), and now every control plane answers and none runs etcd. The operator never bootstraps such a cluster again; a person restores etcd or starts over.
reasons.context: Reasons on the cluster's Bootstrapped / Available conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonRestorePending
reasons.description: the cluster carries os.pk.io/restore-pending, so its etcd is restored from a snapshot by an approved etcdRecover operation and never bootstrapped empty.
reasons.context: Reasons on the cluster's Bootstrapped / Available conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonEtcdUnavailable
reasons.description: the cluster was bootstrapped before, and no member lists etcd members now, while some do not answer or run etcd without a quorum. It may come back.
reasons.context: Reasons on the cluster's Bootstrapped / Available conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonEtcdDataPresent
reasons.description: a cluster not yet bootstrapped has a member whose etcd runs but lists no members, data from an etcd that lost its quorum. Bootstrap is refused until a person restores or resets it.
reasons.context: Reasons on the cluster's Bootstrapped / Available conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonClusterAvailable
reasons.description: ReasonClusterAvailable on Available=True.
reasons.context: Reasons on the cluster's Bootstrapped / Available conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonKubernetesUnreachable
reasons.description: the Kubernetes API does not answer at the endpoint.
reasons.context: Reasons on the cluster's Bootstrapped / Available conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonNodesNotReady
reasons.description: the API answers, but some member TalosNode is not Ready.
reasons.context: Reasons on the cluster's Bootstrapped / Available conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonNotBootstrapped
reasons.description: etcd does not exist yet.
reasons.context: Reasons on the cluster's Bootstrapped / Available conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonInSync
reasons.context: Reasons on ConfigInSync and VersionCurrent.

reasons.name: ReasonConfigDrift
reasons.context: Reasons on ConfigInSync and VersionCurrent.

reasons.name: ReasonDriftUnknown
reasons.context: Reasons on ConfigInSync and VersionCurrent.

reasons.name: ReasonVersionCurrent
reasons.context: Reasons on ConfigInSync and VersionCurrent.

reasons.name: ReasonVersionSkew
reasons.context: Reasons on ConfigInSync and VersionCurrent.

reasons.name: ReasonUnsupportedVersion
reasons.context: Reasons on ConfigInSync and VersionCurrent.

reasons.name: ReasonVersionsSupported
reasons.context: Reasons on ConfigInSync and VersionCurrent.

reasons.name: ReasonVersionsBehind
reasons.context: Reasons on ConfigInSync and VersionCurrent.

reasons.context: Reasons on ConfigInSync and VersionCurrent.

reasons.name: ReasonBundleApplied
reasons.context: Reasons on ConfigInSync and VersionCurrent.

reasons.name: ReasonCredentialsPublished
reasons.context: Reasons on ConfigInSync and VersionCurrent.

reasons.name: ReasonPlanReady
reasons.description: ReasonPlanReady on Planned=True; ReasonPlanBlocked on Planned=False when a step cannot be planned yet (the message says which and why).
reasons.context: Reasons on a TalosRollout's conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonPlanBlocked
reasons.context: Reasons on a TalosRollout's conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonNothingToDo
reasons.description: no node needs the change.
reasons.context: Reasons on a TalosRollout's conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonAwaitingApproval
reasons.description: nobody approved the plan.
reasons.context: Reasons on a TalosRollout's conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonPlanApproved
reasons.description: ReasonPlanApproved on Approved=True.
reasons.context: Reasons on a TalosRollout's conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonPlanChanged
reasons.description: the approval names a planHash the plan no longer has. Nothing runs; approve a new rollout.
reasons.context: Reasons on a TalosRollout's conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonNodeRunning
reasons.description: Progressing reasons.
reasons.context: Reasons on a TalosRollout's conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonWaitingForHealth
reasons.context: Reasons on a TalosRollout's conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonRolloutFailed
reasons.context: Reasons on a TalosRollout's conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonRolloutAborted
reasons.context: Reasons on a TalosRollout's conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonRolloutSucceeded
reasons.context: Reasons on a TalosRollout's conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonCanaryPause
reasons.context: Reasons on a TalosRollout's conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonPausedByPerson
reasons.context: Reasons on a TalosRollout's conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonNotPaused
reasons.context: Reasons on a TalosRollout's conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonRolloutNotStarted
reasons.context: Reasons on a TalosRollout's conditions.

reasons.name: ReasonSinkReady
reasons.context: Reasons of the backup kinds' conditions. Ready uses ReasonSinkReady and the refusals below; BackedUp uses ReasonSnapshotRecent and the gaps below.

reasons.name: ReasonSinkRefused
reasons.description: a pvc sink for the cluster the operator runs on.
reasons.context: Reasons of the backup kinds' conditions. Ready uses ReasonSinkReady and the refusals below; BackedUp uses ReasonSnapshotRecent and the gaps below.

reasons.name: ReasonSinkUnavailable
reasons.description: the sink cannot be used (no backup volume mounted, a credentials Secret missing or incomplete).
reasons.context: Reasons of the backup kinds' conditions. Ready uses ReasonSinkReady and the refusals below; BackedUp uses ReasonSnapshotRecent and the gaps below.

reasons.name: ReasonRecipientsInvalid
reasons.description: an age recipient does not parse.
reasons.context: Reasons of the backup kinds' conditions. Ready uses ReasonSinkReady and the refusals below; BackedUp uses ReasonSnapshotRecent and the gaps below.

reasons.name: ReasonSnapshotRecent
reasons.context: Reasons of the backup kinds' conditions. Ready uses ReasonSinkReady and the refusals below; BackedUp uses ReasonSnapshotRecent and the gaps below.

reasons.name: ReasonNoSnapshot
reasons.description: no verified snapshot yet.
reasons.context: Reasons of the backup kinds' conditions. Ready uses ReasonSinkReady and the refusals below; BackedUp uses ReasonSnapshotRecent and the gaps below.

reasons.name: ReasonBackupTooOld
reasons.description: the newest verified snapshot is older than twice the interval.
reasons.context: Reasons of the backup kinds' conditions. Ready uses ReasonSinkReady and the refusals below; BackedUp uses ReasonSnapshotRecent and the gaps below.

reasons.name: ReasonStored
reasons.description: ReasonStored on Complete=True; ReasonSnapshotFailed on Complete=False (the message says what failed).
reasons.context: Reasons of the backup kinds' conditions. Ready uses ReasonSinkReady and the refusals below; BackedUp uses ReasonSnapshotRecent and the gaps below.

reasons.name: ReasonSnapshotFailed
reasons.context: Reasons of the backup kinds' conditions. Ready uses ReasonSinkReady and the refusals below; BackedUp uses ReasonSnapshotRecent and the gaps below.

reasons.name: ReasonTaking
reasons.description: the snapshot is being taken, or waits for an etcd member to take it from.
reasons.context: Reasons of the backup kinds' conditions. Ready uses ReasonSinkReady and the refusals below; BackedUp uses ReasonSnapshotRecent and the gaps below.

reasons.name: ReasonIntact
reasons.description: ReasonIntact on Verified=True; ReasonDamaged and ReasonReadBackFailed on Verified=False.
reasons.context: Reasons of the backup kinds' conditions. Ready uses ReasonSinkReady and the refusals below; BackedUp uses ReasonSnapshotRecent and the gaps below.

reasons.name: ReasonDamaged
reasons.context: Reasons of the backup kinds' conditions. Ready uses ReasonSinkReady and the refusals below; BackedUp uses ReasonSnapshotRecent and the gaps below.

reasons.name: ReasonReadBackFailed
reasons.context: Reasons of the backup kinds' conditions. Ready uses ReasonSinkReady and the refusals below; BackedUp uses ReasonSnapshotRecent and the gaps below.
